newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mostly lower in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mostly lower in slow trade.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mostly lower in slow trade with slight corrections in blue chips.
* Seven of 12 active issues fell, three rose and two were flat.
* Volume was lower at 6,027 shares and turnover at 2.3 million kuna.
* Biggest loser was Croatia Banka, sliding 5 kuna to 135 on volume of 100 shares. It last traded in November 1996.
* Biggest gainer was textile firm Varteks which inched up five kuna to 85 kuna with 500 units sold.
* Most actively traded stock was food company Podravka, closing five kuna lower at 315 after trading mixed at 308-320 range, with 2,507 shares changing hands.
